name: Balanced accuracy
aggregation: unweighted class recall then unweighted mean across 13 domains

name: Paired balanced-accuracy difference
aggregation: acquisition-aware minus selected classical per domain

name: Macro F1
aggregation: fold predictions pooled then class-unweighted F1

name: Per-class recall
aggregation: correct class predictions divided by class support

name: Worst-domain balanced accuracy
aggregation: minimum over eligible domains

name: Instrument-balanced master BA
aggregation: average within instrument then equally across instruments

name: Negative log likelihood
aggregation: mean true-class negative log probability

name: Multiclass Brier score
aggregation: mean squared probability error

name: Expected calibration error
aggregation: equal-mass 10-bin weighted calibration gap

name: Selective risk
aggregation: error among accepted predictions by retained coverage

name: Unknown AUROC
aggregation: known versus held-unknown score ranking

name: Unknown AUPR
aggregation: unknown-positive precision recall area

name: OSCR-AUC
aggregation: correct-known versus accepted-unknown operating area

name: FPR at 95 percent known recall
aggregation: false unknown acceptance at fixed known recall

name: Target-adjusted instrument probe increment
aggregation: spectral probe cell-BA minus chemistry-null cell-BA

name: Target-adjusted sensor probe increment
aggregation: spectral probe cell-BA minus chemistry-null cell-BA

name: Cross-instrument same-master cosine distance
aggregation: mean pair distance after equal master weighting

name: Correctness-conditioned prediction agreement
aggregation: agreement separated by correct/wrong status

name: Robustness degradation AUC
aggregation: area of BA loss versus perturbation magnitude

name: K-means metadata NMI
aggregation: normalized mutual information with target instrument sensor

name: HDBSCAN noise fraction
aggregation: fraction assigned noise

name: Embedding silhouette
aggregation: silhouette for declared grouping

name: Training time
aggregation: wall-clock seconds

name: Inference latency
aggregation: median and p95 milliseconds

name: Serialized model size
aggregation: bytes on disk

name: Paired preprocessing-policy BA difference
aggregation: candidate policy minus PP-U-MIN on identical test UIDs
interpretation: Policy effect without changing the independent unit

name: Preprocessing-by-model interaction contrast
aggregation: policy effect for deep minus policy effect for classical
interpretation: Whether preprocessing changes the learning-strategy conclusion

name: Preprocessing-policy coverage
aggregation: eligible nonfallback rows and domains divided by declared denominator
interpretation: Applicability and fallback burden rather than predictive quality

name: Preprocessing-action selection stability
aggregation: agreement or entropy across repeats and source pseudo-domain perturbations
interpretation: Whether a selected family mapping or QC gate is reproducible

name: Preprocessing preservation-guardrail violation rate
aggregation: fraction below declared shape peak or validity guardrail with fallback retained
interpretation: Transformation harm audit not clean-signal recovery
